dimensions.assessment: Affects manufacturers of showerheads and homeowners subject to federal water efficiency standards.
dimensions.evidence: The bill provides statutory authority for a revised definition of showerhead for the purpose of federal water efficiency regulations.

dimensions.assessment: Makes an administrative and technical adjustment to regulatory definitions rather than altering major government programs.
dimensions.evidence: Specifically, the bill adopts the definition of showerhead established by the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME).

dimensions.assessment: Involves minor administrative rulemaking by the Department of Energy with no stated fiscal or economic cost impacts.
Amends the Energy Policy and Conservation Act definition and requires the Department of Energy to revise related regulations within 180 days.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Energy Policy and Conservation Act to revise the definition of showerhead.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent statutory definition change and a one-time rulemaking deadline.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Energy shall promulgate such revisions to regulations

missing_information: Economic or water-usage impact data resulting from the definition change.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill adopts a specific industry definition for showerheads for federal water efficiency regulations and directs the Department of Energy to update its regulations accordingly.
